branding_note.vi: NASA's Eyes là ứng dụng của NASA/JPL. Khi nhúng, giữ nguyên giao diện và logo của NASA bên trong khung, ghi rõ 'Eyes on the Solar System / Eyes on the Earth — NASA/JPL-Caltech' và có liên kết mở trang gốc. Không dùng logo NASA cho MIAUDOW và không ngụ ý NASA bảo trợ hay xác nhận MIAUDOW.
branding_note.en: NASA's Eyes is a NASA/JPL application. When framed, keep NASA's interface and insignia inside the frame unchanged, credit 'Eyes on the Solar System / Eyes on the Earth — NASA/JPL-Caltech' with a link to the original, never use the NASA insignia for MIAUDOW, and never imply NASA endorsement.

usage_notes: The Solar System app ships an official Share > Embed generator that outputs <iframe src=... allowfullscreen>; its embed options include tracking=false.
Deep links were verified against the apps' public JavaScript bundles and NASA's own links, not by rendering them in a browser.
Both apps load WebGL scenes of tens of MB: load them only on demand (click to open), never on farmer routes, with reduced motion respected.
